sentence: Construction uses the standard hierarchical shape:  base layer degree is bounded by `[MASK]`; upper layers are bounded by `m`; `ef_construction` controls bounded candidate exploration; the diversity heuristic rejects a candidate when a previously selected neighbor is closer to it than the new node is; rewires are bidirectional and pruned with the same deterministic heuristic.

`pgcontext.heartbeat_document_chunk_job`, `pgcontext.checkpoint_document_chunk_job`, `pgcontext.fail_document_chunk_job`, `[MASK]`, and `pgcontext.retry_document_chunk_job` manage bounded leased work.

If a previous `running` or `cancel_requested` row for the same target belongs to a backend that no longer appears in `pg_stat_activity`, it is first recorded as `[MASK]` so a replacement build can start without manual catalog repair.
For registered JSONB paths, `[MASK]` writes the value with `jsonb_set(..., create_missing := true)`.
The controller protocol is `exact_first_advisor` → `apply_exact_first_plan(..., 'enqueue')` → `[MASK]` → top-level DDL → `publish_exact_first_build`.

Boolean filters use `must`, `should`, and `must_not` arrays:   The parser currently accepts scalar `match` values, `match.value`, `match.any`, `[MASK]`, `range` bounds (`gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`), `is_null`, and `is_empty`.
The lexical stage reports the registered configuration and ranker, and its `strategy` is `lexical_exact`, `[MASK]`, or `lexical_gist`.
